summary.text: This opportunity briefing explores combining normalizing flows, parameter estimation, and regression for simulation-based estimation under complex distributions. Normalizing flows transform unknown residual distributions into simple base distributions while regression and parameter estimation handle inference tasks. Evidence shows this approach handles non-Gaussian, multi-modal uncertainties in computational models.

target_user.text: The target user includes researchers and engineers working with probabilistic modeling, simulation-based inference, and statistical machine learning using repositories such as atong01/conditional-flow-matching and statmixedml/xgboostlss.

jtbd.text: When researchers need to perform simulation-based parameter estimation under non-Gaussian, multi-modal uncertainties, they want to leverage normalizing flows embedded within regression frameworks so that they can accurately capture complex residual distributions and improve inference.

value_prop.text: Integrating normalizing flows into regression-based parameter estimation overcomes the limitations of traditional filtering methods that struggle with arbitrary non-Gaussian distributions. It provides a robust, end-to-end framework for handling intractable residual distributions in physical simulations.

riskiest_assumption.text: The riskiest assumption is that commercial buyers will pay for a software package combining normalizing flows and regression for parameter estimation; this axis V is designated as the riskiest due to missing evidence in the bundle.

mvp.text: Conduct customer interviews and a price acceptance test with a prototype workflow combining torchcfm and xgboostlss to gauge willingness to pay for simulation-based parameter estimation tools.
mvp.type: customer interviews and price acceptance test

success_metric.text: Achieve a proposed threshold of 40 percent positive willingness-to-pay responses during customer price acceptance interviews.

kill_criteria.text: Fewer than a proposed threshold of 10 percent of interviewed prospective users express interest in purchasing a combined normalizing flow and regression parameter estimation tool.

open_source.use: Used as a conditional flow matching library to support flow-based transformations.
Used for probabilistic modeling extensions in regression-based estimation tasks.

to_build.text: A unified integration pipeline that links embedded normalizing flow transformations with probabilistic regression estimators for end-io-end parameter inference.
